verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a locally run AI video-production app with CLI and agent integrations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only README usage examples (npm run post-video, npm run doctor) and configuration variables. There is no API reference, interactive or otherwise, and no runnable examples, and the docs-md probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
